lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-rectilinear grid. Larger centroids (approx. diameter 10-20 pixels) are positioned along the mid-lateral axis, while smaller, higher-frequency clusters are concentrated in the antero-dorsal region near the head.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a matrix of anchor nodes most distinct in the region posterior to the branchial slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible running longitudinally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and a shadow-induced low intensity on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Five vertical branchial slits exhibit high-contrast shadow regions; presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae individuals visible adjacent to the ventral-lateral midline and pectoral fin.
